description: Heuristic review leads from CSS, markup, and common utility-class patterns. It does not prove per-view semantics or accessibility.

S1.name: Blocker
S1.definition: User cannot make the decision, is likely to make a wrong one, an accessibility gate fails, or a destructive action is unsafely presented.

S2.name: Major
S2.definition: Decision is possible but materially slower or error-prone.

S3.name: Minor
S3.definition: Adds friction or inconsistency without threatening the decision.

S4.name: Polish
S4.definition: Craft refinement with no functional impact.

rules.name: Accent color scarcity
rules.check: Accent color appears at most twice per view: the P0 and the primary action.
rules.fix: Replace surplus accent usage with neutral values.

rules.name: Space before borders
rules.check: Grouping is expressed by spacing; borders added only where space cannot work.
rules.fix: Remove borders that spacing already implies.

rules.name: One primary per scope
rules.check: At most one primary per scope value; at most 2 filled high-emphasis treatments per viewport.
rules.fix: Demote surplus primaries to secondary or overflow.

rules.name: Verb plus object labels
rules.check: Every label is a verb plus an object, 3 words or fewer, in user vocabulary.
rules.fix: Rewrite Submit, OK, Go, Continue, Manage, Update with outcome-naming labels.

rules.name: Icon-only requires a name
rules.check: Every icon-only control has an accessible name and a tooltip.
rules.fix: Add accessible name plus tooltip, or add a visible label.

rules.name: Secondary weight caution
rules.check: Dense surfaces such as toolbars, rows, and card footers use ladder ranks 4 to 8 only.
rules.fix: Replace outlined secondaries with subtle or text treatments in dense surfaces.

rules.name: Never disable silently
rules.check: Every disabled control exposes the reason and the condition to enable it.
rules.fix: Add tooltip or adjacent text, or keep enabled and explain on activation.

rules.name: Never name groups by type or source
rules.check: No zone heading is a component type, a chart type, or a system name.
rules.fix: Rename using the user question or the object.

rules.name: Signposted disclosure
rules.check: Collapsed regions state what they contain and, where cheap, how much.
rules.fix: Add descriptive labels and counts to disclosure triggers.

rules.name: User vocabulary
rules.check: No schema names, internal codenames, or unexplained abbreviations appear in the UI.
rules.fix: Rename to the user term; add a definition affordance.

rules.name: Units and precision
rules.check: Units are stated; precision matches the decision, not the database.
rules.fix: Round for summaries; keep full precision in detail and export.

rules.name: Chart from question
rules.check: Chart type follows the question per the selection table.
rules.fix: Replace with the chart matching the question. No 3D, no dual axes, no pies over 3 slices.

rules.name: Axis discipline
rules.check: Axes are labeled with units; bar value axes start at zero; gridlines minimized.
rules.fix: Fix axes and remove non-informative lines.

rules.name: Full state set specified
rules.check: Every data region specifies loading, empty first-use, empty filtered, partial, stale, error, no permission, and too much data.
rules.fix: Specify the missing states.

rules.name: No layout shift on load
rules.check: Loading skeletons match final dimensions.
rules.fix: Match skeleton geometry to final content.

rules.name: Type scale limits
rules.check: At most 5 type sizes, 3 weights, 3 text colors per view.
rules.fix: Collapse to the scale.

rules.name: Tokenized spacing
rules.check: Every margin, padding, and gap uses a spacing token.
rules.fix: Replace arbitrary values with tokens.

rules.name: Semantic token names
rules.check: Token names describe role, not appearance.
rules.fix: Rename literal tokens to semantic ones.

rules.name: Module consistency
rules.check: All modules share padding, radius, border, and title treatment unless variation encodes meaning.
rules.fix: Standardize module chrome.

rules.name: Non-data ink justified
rules.check: Every decorative element justifies its presence against the data it competes with.
rules.fix: Remove decoration: gradients, superfluous icons, 3D, animated counters.

rules.name: Semantic elevation
rules.check: Shadow encodes transience; permanent surfaces do not float.
rules.fix: Remove decorative shadows.

rules.name: One radius family
rules.check: At most 2 radius values per view, applied consistently.
rules.fix: Standardize radii.

rules.name: Cards versus tables
rules.check: Homogeneous comparable records use a table, not a card grid.
rules.fix: Convert card grids of identical records to tables.

rules.name: Restraint budget
rules.check: Per view: 5 type sizes, 3 weights, 3 text colors, 1 accent hue, 6 data colors, 2 border styles, 2 radii, 2 shadow levels, 1 icon style.
rules.fix: Reduce each overage.

rules.name: Alignment discipline
rules.check: Elements align to the grid; alignment edges minimized; numbers right-aligned; text left-aligned.
rules.fix: Fix alignment and never center-align data columns.

rules.name: Rhythm limit
rules.check: At most 3 distinct vertical spacing values between siblings within a zone.
rules.fix: Collapse to 3 values.

rules.name: Text contrast
rules.check: 4.5:1 for text under 18px or under 14px bold; 3:1 for larger.
rules.fix: Raise contrast. Do not lower it for aesthetic lightness.

rules.name: Non-text contrast
rules.check: 3:1 for UI boundaries, icons, focus rings, and meaningful chart marks.
rules.fix: Raise contrast of controls and data marks.

rules.name: Color independence
rules.check: No meaning is conveyed by color alone.
rules.fix: Pair color with text, icon, pattern, or position.

rules.name: Focus visible
rules.check: Every interactive element has a visible focus indicator at 3:1 against adjacent colors.
rules.fix: Restore and strengthen focus indicators.

rules.name: Accessible names
rules.check: Every control has an accessible name; icon-only controls have explicit labels.
rules.fix: Add accessible names.

rules.name: Target size
rules.check: 44x44px minimum for touch; 24x24px with adequate spacing for pointer.
rules.fix: Increase target size or spacing.

rules.name: Motion safety
rules.check: Reduced-motion preference respected; no essential meaning conveyed only by motion.
rules.fix: Add reduced-motion handling.

rules.name: Heading structure
rules.check: Logical heading levels, no skipped levels, one h1 per view.
rules.fix: Fix heading hierarchy.

rules.name: Error identification
rules.check: Errors are identified in text, associated with their field, and describe the remedy.
rules.fix: Add text errors bound to fields.
